levels.surface: أبي بكر بن عبد الله بن قيس

notes: «- واللفظ لأبي غسان -» is an editor's gloss on the wording: left out; the isnad words inside the dashes («قال حدثنا أبو عبد الصمد») are read as part of that wording's route and kept (not verified against another copy)
«أبو عبد الصمد» is a bare kunya, written as it stands (owner ruling 3)
«عن أبيه» is a relation with no name; the Prophet ends the chain (rule 12)
